query: The Rise of the “N=1” App: When Building It Yourself Really Beats Buying It.
answer:
The Rise of the “N=1” App: When Building It Yourself Really Beats Buying It.

What do we mean? Well, I’ve been doing SaaS since 2005 and watching start-ups go from tiny to $100m+ valuations in just years … with millions of customers. And something weird happened around late 2020/early 2021. More folks started building their own apps. Not buying them — especially internal tools that have always seemed like they’d never get built because they don’t seem worth enough. Why would anyone build an app when someone else already does most of what you need?

But if there’s one thing that makes me confident in our future together as founders and operators, it’s seeing how much people will put up with suboptimal software. That
